angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 401,628 km at 6.33 pc = 0.85 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 157.8879 +/- 0.0197 mas (same row, RUWE 1.08): 6.33 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.5773 +/- 0.0131 solar radii from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 338A: radius in solar radii, 0.5773 +/- 0.0131, from this work (CHARA) (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112): 401,628 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.622 solar masses from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 338A: mass 0.622 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3907 +/- 35 K from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 338A: effective temperature in K, 3907 +/- 35, from this work (CHARA) (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 338A: effective temperature in K, 3907 +/- 35, from this work (CHARA) (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/gj-338-a.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.709, rounded to two decimals
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, HD 79210: projected rotation speed 2.75 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2024A&A...687A.205M)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
